summary: Public scan() trusts its caller: target goes into argv unchecked and there is no -- end-of-options marker; safety relies on one caller convention
evidence: clamav.rs:64-69 command.args(scan_args(target)); only production caller scan.rs:141 after validate_target (scan.rs:140)
failure_scenario: A future direct caller passing --remove=yes would make clamscan delete files, bypassing the quarantine rule in CLAUDE.md. No current exploit path.
